description: This file defines the AnalyticsManager class responsible for logging various analytics events in the application using Firebase Analytics.

classes.name: AnalyticsManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages logging of analytics events using Firebase Analytics.

methods.name: logScreenView
methods.description: Logs a screen view event with the given screen name and class.

methods.name: logCoinView
methods.description: Logs a view event for a specific coin identified by its ID and name.

methods.name: logPortfolioAction
methods.description: Logs an action taken on the portfolio with the action type and coin ID.

methods.name: logWatchlistAction
methods.description: Logs an action related to the watchlist with action type and coin ID.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error event with error details and additional parameters.
